answer_1.quote: Knowledge-grounded dialogue systems generate informative responses by incorporating external knowledge...
answer_1.outputs: responses in a dialogue context based on external knowledge

answer_2.quote: Following previous works, we employ 1) ROUGE, BLEU, Meteor, and unigram overlap (F1) to evaluate the quality of the generated responses; and 2) Recall@k, which calculates the percentage of ground-truth knowledge included in the top-k selections, to evaluate the knowledge selection accuracy.

answer_4.quote: Considering the cost of human evaluation, we follow recent works... The percentages represent the proportion of responses that outperform one another.
answer_4.guideline: We provide conversation history and instruct ChatGPT to generate responses using the selected knowledge or relying solely on its internal knowledge. Humans evaluate which response is better in terms of engaging and informative quality.
